records.jp: いや、私にはそんな必要は……
records.en_original: That's entirely unnecessary...
records.en_auxiliary: That's entirely unnecessary.
records.en: That's entirely unnecessary...

records.jp: ダメだよ！　ちゃんとしないと
records.en_original: Don't be like that! You need take care of yourself.
records.en_auxiliary: Don't be like that! You need to take care of yourself.
records.en: Don't be like that! You need take care of yourself.

records.jp: うう……
records.en_original: Ugh...
records.en_auxiliary: Ugh...
records.en: Ugh...

records.jp: （あれ……有理と早苗が言い争ってる……？<CR>でも、何だか有理が押されてるように見えるけど……）
records.en_original: (Huh? Are Yuri and Sanae arguing...? But it looks like Yuri is being pushed back...)
records.en_auxiliary: (Huh? Are Yuri and Sanae arguing? But it looks like Yuri is being pushed back...)
records.en: (Huh? Are Yuri and Sanae arguing...? But it looks like Yuri is being pushed back...)

records.jp: 二人とも、どうしたの？
records.en_original: What's wrong, you two?
records.en_auxiliary: What's wrong, you two?
records.en: What's wrong, you two?

records.jp: あ、日菜子ちゃん！
records.en_original: Oh, Hinako!
records.en_auxiliary: Oh, Hinako!
records.en: Oh, Hinako-chan!

records.jp: 斎木さんにね、いつも科学部の部室にいるから<CR>普段の食事をどうしてるのか聞いたんだけど……
records.en_original: Saiki's always in the science room, so I was asking her what she usually eats...
records.en_auxiliary: Saiki's always in the science room, so I was asking her what she usually eats.
records.en: Saiki-san's always in the science room, so I was asking her what she usually eats...

records.jp: 食事をとる時間も決まってないし、<CR>食べるとしてもネットで買ったものばかりって！
records.en_original: She said she never eats at regular times, and she's always just eating stuff she buys online!
records.en_auxiliary: She said she never eats at regular times, and she's always just eating stuff she buys online!
records.en: She said she never eats at regular times, and she's always just eating stuff she buys online!

records.jp: そんな食生活じゃ、研究してる間に<CR>突然倒れちゃうよ！
records.en_original: If she keeps eating like that, she'll end up collapsing during her research one day!
records.en_auxiliary: If she keeps eating like that, she'll end up collapsing during her research one day!
records.en: If she keeps eating like that, she'll end up collapsing during her research one day!

records.jp: （うん……早苗は料理部だし、<CR>有理の食生活を知ったら心配にもなるよね……）
records.en_original: (Yeah... Sanae is in the cooking club, so of course she'd worry if she learned about Yuri's eating habits...)
records.en_auxiliary: (Oh yeah, Sanae is in the cooking club, so of course she'd worry if she learned about Yuri's eating habits.)
records.en: (Yeah... Sanae is in the cooking club, so of course she'd worry if she learned about Yuri's eating habits...)

records.jp: むう……では栄養を効率よく摂取できるサプリメントを<CR>常備しておくとしよう。それならば――
records.en_original: Grr... Okay, then I'll keep some efficient nutrition supplements at hand. That should more than suffice...
records.en_auxiliary: Grr... Okay, then I'll keep some efficient nutrition supplements on hand. That should more than suffice—
records.en: Grr... Okay, then I'll keep some efficient nutrition supplements at hand. That should more than suffice...

records.jp: ダメ！　それも飲むのを忘れちゃったら何にも意味がないでしょ？
records.en_original: Not good enough! Besides, what's the point of nutrition supplements if you forget to take them?
records.en_auxiliary: Not good enough! Besides, what's the point of nutrition supplements if you forget to take them?
records.en: Not good enough! Besides, what's the point of nutrition supplements if you forget to take them?

records.jp: ならば、自動で食事が配達されるよう、<CR>ネットに定期的に発注するようなプログラムを組んで――
records.en_original: In that case, I'll make a program that automatically orders food online at set intervals...
records.en_auxiliary: In that case, I'll make a program that automatically orders food online at set intervals.
records.en: In that case, I'll make a program that automatically orders food online at set intervals...

records.jp: インターネットに頼りすぎるのもダメ！<CR>いつでも繋がるわけじゃないんだから！
records.en_original: Don't rely on the internet so much! It's not like you can be online all the time!
records.en_auxiliary: Don't rely on the internet so much! It's not like you can be online all the time!
records.en: Don't rely on the internet so much! It's not like you can be online all the time!

records.jp: さ、早苗も少し落ち着いて……？<CR>気持ちはわかるけど……
records.en_original: S-Sanae, maybe you should calm down a little...? I understand how you feel, but...
records.en_auxiliary: S-Sanae, maybe you should calm down a little? I understand how you feel, but...
records.en: S-Sanae, maybe you should calm down a little...? I understand how you feel, but...

records.jp: 日菜子ちゃん……でも、やっぱり見てられないよ……
records.en_original: Hinako... I can't just stand by and watch this...
records.en_auxiliary: Hinako, I can't just stand by and watch this.
records.en: Hinako-chan... I can't just stand by and watch this...

records.jp: こ、これは私の問題だ。<CR>君たちが口を挟む問題では……
records.en_original: Th-This is my issue and mine alone. Neither of you need to involve yourselves...
records.en_auxiliary: Th-this is my issue and mine alone. Neither of you need to involve yourselves.
records.en: Th-This is my issue and mine alone. Neither of you need to involve yourselves...

records.jp: 有理……
records.en_original: Yuri...
records.en_auxiliary: Yuri...
records.en: Yuri...

records.jp: 有理が倒れると、みんなも大変なんだよ。<CR>科学部室で干からびちゃってたら大事件だし
records.en_original: We'd all be sad if you collapsed... And it would be quite a scene if we found your shriveled corpse in the science room.
records.en_auxiliary: We'd all be sad if something happened to you. And it would be quite a scene if we found your shriveled corpse in the science room.
records.en: We'd all be sad if you collapsed... And it would be quite a scene if we found your shriveled corpse in the science room.

records.jp: む……そ、そうならないようには気をつけるつもりだ
records.en_original: Nn... I-I'm being careful enough about that.
records.en_auxiliary: Nnn... I-I'm being careful enough about that.
records.en: Nn... I-I'm being careful enough about that.

records.jp: 斎木さんが研究熱心なのはすごいと思うけど……<CR>その研究も、健康じゃないと続けられないよ
records.en_original: Your passion for studying is amazing, but... You can't do research if you aren't healthy.
records.en_auxiliary: Your passion for studying is amazing, but you can't do research if you aren't healthy.
records.en: I think your passion for research is admirable, Saiki-san, but...<CR>you can't keep researching if you aren't healthy.

records.jp: うんうん。<CR>それに、有理も私たちの大事な仲間だしね
records.en_original: Yeah, that's right. Plus, you're an important friend to us. We don't want to see you hurt yourself.
records.en_auxiliary: Yeah, that's right. Plus, you're an important friend to us. We don't want to see you hurt yourself.
records.en: Yeah, that's right. Plus, you're an important friend to us. We don't want to see you hurt yourself.

records.jp: 仲間……
records.en_original: A friend...
records.en_auxiliary: A friend...
records.en: A friend...

records.jp: ね、ここは自分のためでだけじゃなくて<CR>みんなのためでもあると思って
records.en_original: So don't think of it as doing something just for yourself. It's for our sakes just as much as yours.
records.en_auxiliary: So don't think of it as doing something just for yourself. It's for our sakes just as much as yours.
records.en: So don't think of it as doing something just for yourself. It's for our sakes just as much as yours.

records.jp: ……そうだな、善処しよう。<CR>なるべく、できる限り
records.en_original: ...You're right, I'll be careful. To the extent that I can, at least.
records.en_auxiliary: I understand. I'll be careful. To the extent that I can, at least.
records.en: ...You're right, I'll be careful. To the extent that I can, at least.

records.jp: できる限りって……大丈夫かなあ。<CR>ご飯、最後に食べたの昨日とかじゃないよね？
records.en_original: "To the extent that you can"? ...I don't know about that. Don't tell me, your last proper meal was yesterday?
records.en_auxiliary: To the extent that you can? ...I don't know about that. Don't tell me, your last proper meal was yesterday?
records.en: "To the extent that you can"? ...I don't know about that. Don't tell me, your last proper meal was yesterday?

records.jp: そ、それは……
records.en_original: P-Perhaps..
records.en_auxiliary: P-perhaps...
records.en: P-Perhaps..

records.jp: もし有理一人だけの問題だったとしても、<CR>みんな心配してるってことだよ
records.en_original: Even if it is your issue, everyone's still worried.
records.en_auxiliary: Even if it is your issue, everyone's still worried.
records.en: Even if it is your issue, everyone's still worried.

records.jp: 一緒に原種に立ち向かう仲間だし、<CR>友達として元気でいてほしいから言ってるの
records.en_original: You're facing the Sephirot with us, and we want you to be healthy, as your friends.
records.en_auxiliary: You're facing the Sephira with us, and we want you to be healthy. As your friends.
records.en: You're facing the Sephirot with us, and we want you to be healthy, as your friends.

records.jp: 心配……。<CR>そうか、私のような者でも心配されるのか……
records.en_original: You're worried...? I see, so you'd even worry about someone like me...
records.en_auxiliary: You're worried? About me? So you'd even worry about someone like me...
records.en: You're worried...? I see, so you'd even worry about someone like me...

records.jp: 斎木さん、もしかして心配されるのは嫌？
records.en_original: Does that bother you?
records.en_auxiliary: Does that bother you?
records.en: Saiki-san, do you dislike people worrying about you?

records.jp: ……いや、そんなことはない
records.en_original: ...No, that's not it.
records.en_auxiliary: ...No, that's not it.
records.en: ...No, that's not it.

records.jp: これまでそういった経験が<CR>ほとんどなかったから……不思議な気分だ
records.en_original: It's just, I don't believe I've ever experienced something like this... It's a strange feeling.
records.en_auxiliary: It's just, I don't believe I've ever experienced something like this. It's a strange feeling.
records.en: It's just, I don't believe I've ever experienced something like this... It's a strange feeling.

records.jp: これからきっと、たくさん心配されるよ。<CR>有理のことを気にかけてる人は今までよりも増えてるんだから
records.en_original: I'm sure we'll worry about you plenty more. And Sanae and I aren't the only ones.
records.en_auxiliary: I'm sure we'll worry about you plenty more. And Sanae and I aren't the only ones.
records.en: I'm sure we'll worry about you plenty more. And Sanae and I aren't the only ones.

records.jp: うんうん、斎木さんは一人じゃないんだよ。<CR>だから、これからはしっかりご飯食べてね？
records.en_original: Yup, you aren't alone, Saiki. So make sure you start eating properly, okay?
records.en_auxiliary: Yup, you aren't alone, Saiki. So make sure you start eating properly, okay?
records.en: Yup, you aren't alone, Saiki-san. So make sure you start eating properly, okay?

records.jp: それは大丈夫だ。<CR>……おそらく
records.en_original: I'll be fine... I think.
records.en_auxiliary: I'll be fine. I think.
records.en: I'll be fine... I think.

records.jp: 本当に大丈夫かなあ
records.en_original: Are you sure about that?
records.en_auxiliary: Are you sure about that?
records.en: Are you sure about that?

records.jp: あ……そういえばこの間も<CR>有理、お腹が空いて死にそうって連絡を私に……
records.en_original: Oh... That reminds me, Yuri said she was so hungry she felt like she was about to die the other day...
records.en_auxiliary: Oh, that reminds me! Yuri said she was so hungry she felt like she was about to die the other day.
records.en: Oh... That reminds me, Yuri said she was so hungry she felt like she was about to die the other day...

records.jp: え、そうなの、日菜子ちゃん！？
records.en_original: Wait, are you serious, Hinako!?
records.en_auxiliary: Wait, are you serious, Hinako?!
records.en: Wait, are you serious, Hinako-chan!?

records.jp: じゃあやっぱり直さなきゃだめだよ！<CR>まずは一日三食しっかり食べるところから――
records.en_original: Then you really do need to fix this! First, you need to start eating three square meals a day, then...
records.en_auxiliary: Then you really do need to fix this! First, you need to start eating three square meals a day.
records.en: Then you really do need to fix this! First, you need to start eating three square meals a day, then...

records.jp: も、もう勘弁してくれ！<CR>私は研究に戻る！
records.en_original: L-Leave me be! I'm going back to my research!
records.en_auxiliary: L-leave me be! I'm going back to my research!
records.en: L-Leave me be! I'm going back to my research!

records.jp: あ、待って、斎木さん……！<CR>話はまだ終わってないんだよ！
records.en_original: Hey, wait, Saiki...! I'm not done with you yet!
records.en_auxiliary: Hey, wait, Saiki! I'm not done with you yet!
records.en: Hey, wait, Saiki-san...! I'm not done with you yet!

records.jp: あはは……有理があんなに慌ててるの、<CR>すごく珍しいかも……
records.en_original: Ahaha... It's really unusual to see Yuri so flustered...
records.en_auxiliary: Ahaha! It's really unusual to see Yuri so flustered.
records.en: Ahaha... It's really unusual to see Yuri so flustered...
